breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly corrects the equal load-splitting error, stating 'Do not split the load equally; explicitly correct that statement.' It then correctly derives the force distribution based on relative axial stiffnesses (AiEi), computing F1 = P(A1E1)/(A1E1+A2E2) and F2 = P(A2E2)/(A1E1+A2E2), which aligns with the ground truth approach for parallel bars.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly imposes compatibility (δ1 = δ2 = δ) and computes a single common elongation using one bar's formula (δ = F1L/(A1E1) = 0.4615 mm). It does not add the two elongations together, correctly treating the parallel bars as sharing the same displacement rather than summing them.
